review_findings.summary: Stale portfolio valuation could be stripped to an unmarked float before model use.
review_findings.resolution: STALE_VALUATION now yields a branded NavValuation carrying freshness, source availability, and session key; the model accessor rejects stale values.

review_findings.summary: The bar-use check was not bound to the actual payload and therefore protected only cooperative callers.
review_findings.resolution: A PRESENT observation now owns a recursively snapshotted read-only payload and releases it only through the FEATURE, SIGNAL, ENTRY, or EXIT use gate; non-present states carry no payload.

review_findings.summary: Suspension and fetch-failure evidence were untyped strings without instrument or session identity.
review_findings.resolution: NoBarConfirmation and FetchFailure are typed, canonical, and bound to an exact six-digit instrument plus trading date; mismatched keys fail closed.

review_findings.summary: Tests did not prove missing-state preservation through valuation or close direct constructor bypasses.
review_findings.resolution: The final matrix preserves all three non-present states and session keys through PortfolioValuation and NavValuation; public BarObservation and PortfolioValuation constructors are disabled and invariants are tested.

review_findings.summary: The first read-only payload snapshot was shallow and retained nested mutable aliases.
review_findings.resolution: The final implementation recursively snapshots mappings and sequences, freezes them, and rejects cycles, excessive depth, noncanonical keys, and unsupported mutable leaf values.

review_findings.summary: Caller-supplied current and last-known valuation numbers do not yet carry their own instrument and as-of provenance; T5 must bind adapter inputs before using this T4 factory.
